stories.title: Specialty Match Transparency Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define response schema to expose matched_classifications and pipeline origin metadata (regex, vector, or both). Include fields for classification label, optional confidence score, and source_pipeline.

stories.title: Pipeline Attribution Logic
stories.description: Enhance specialty_service to tag each matched classification with its originating pipeline (regex, vector, or merged) and ensure deduplicated classifications retain provenance metadata across both pipelines.

stories.title: API Exposure of Specialty Transparency
stories.description: Update find_care_facade, tool_router, and provider_search_models to include matched classifications with pipeline attribution in API responses for downstream chat consumption.

stories.title: Frontend Rendering of Match Transparency
stories.description: Update MessageBubble rendering logic to optionally display specialty match explanations, including classification labels and pipeline origin indicators, in a concise and user-readable format.

stories.title: Specialty Transparency Tests and Integration
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating pipeline attribution correctness, schema compliance in API responses, tool_router propagation, and frontend rendering behavior for transparency metadata.
